name: Google Drive
description: Typed Google Drive files, sharing, shared drives, changes, revisions, comments and bounded byte transfers.

permissions.description: Explicit HTTPS Google Drive v3 requests; encrypted supplied OAuth token or selected connection credentials. Confirmed operations can create, share, alter and permanently delete resources. Alternative secrets require host authorization. No filesystem, token refresh, retries or listeners.

definitions.name: List Files
definitions.documentation: List Files: GET /files. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.name: Get File Metadata
definitions.documentation: Get File Metadata: GET /files/{fileId}. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. definitions.name: Generate File IDs
definitions.documentation: Generate File IDs: GET /files/generateIds. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.name: Create File Permission
definitions.documentation: Create File Permission: POST /files/{fileId}/permissions. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation PERMISSIONS_CREATE. External action may succeed before a timeout; reconcile before repeating. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file.
